Luanshi contributors fitted the gate span and passage height to the playable River Gate wall, split masonry, upper storey and roof pitches for the camera, and filtered the diffuse atlas into matte tile, wood and plaster. This is an adaptation of a historical game asset, not an archaeological reconstruction.
